title: Exercise translation
description: Validates data/i18n/<lang>/<id>.yaml. One file per exercise per language — a new language is a new directory, not a schema change.

status.description: Document-level, not per-field — texts are translated and reviewed as a whole. `upstream_unreviewed` is the state after import: written by humans, but never reviewed by this project, and lacking author attribution in 511 entries. `human` explicitly means reviewed by a person. `ai_reviewed` means reviewed and corrected if needed. `ai_authored` designates texts newly composed from scratch or completely rewritten compared to upstream.

search_terms.description: Synonyms and common misspellings. Indexed for search, never displayed.

upstream.description: wger licenses PER TRANSLATION. See SCHEMA.md 3b.
